map.由名义收益率与通胀率求实际收益率 使用指南: Real Return from Nominal Return and Inflation - User Guide
map.输入名义投资收益率 r_nom 与通货膨胀率 i，按 r_real = (1+r: Enter the nominal investment return r_nom and the inflation rate i, then compute the real return with r_real = (1+r_nom)/(1+i) - 1, which removes inflation to measure the real growth in purchasing power and supports investment decisions.
map.输入名义收益率 r_nom 与通货膨胀率 i，求实际收益率。: Enter the nominal return r_nom and the inflation rate i to compute the real return.
map.名义收益减通胀看真实购买力增长。: Subtract inflation from the nominal return to see the real growth in purchasing power.
map.剔除通货膨胀后，看购买力是否真的获得了增长。: Strip out inflation to see whether purchasing power actually grew.
map.：实际 = (1.08/1.03) − 1 = 4.85%。即真实购买力年增约: Real = (1.08/1.03) - 1 = 4.85%. That is, real purchasing power grows about 4.85% a year, not the 8% on paper.
map.名义收益率填 0.07，通货膨胀率填 0.03: Enter 0.07 for the nominal return and 0.03 for the inflation rate
map.：精确值 r_real=1.07/1.03−1≈3.88%（页面按两位小数显示）: The exact value r_real = 1.07/1.03-1 = about 3.88% (the page shows two decimals); using 7%-3% = 4.00% slightly overstates the real return.

map.由净资产收益率与留存收益率求可持续增长率: Sustainable growth rate from ROE and retention ratio
map.近似 5% 小误差可接受，但精确用 (1+n)/(1+i)−1 才对，通胀高时差: An approximation of 5% error is acceptable, but the exact form (1+n)/(1+i)-1 is correct; the gap becomes obvious at high inflation.
map.为什么不能用减法近似？: Why Can't I Use the Subtraction Approximation?
map.因为名义收益与通胀是相乘而非相加关系。低通胀时两者接近，通胀越高偏差越大：名义: Because the nominal return and inflation combine multiplicatively, not additively. At low inflation the two are close; the higher the inflation, the larger the gap: with 10% nominal and 20% inflation the exact real return is 1.10/1.20-1 = -8.33%, while subtraction gives -10%, which is clearly too pessimistic.
